The citrate phenotype may be due to iron deprivation (via chelation by the citrate) leading to heavy metal stress. The cobalt phenotype is more conserved. AO353_26685 is annotated as performing zinc or cadium efflux as well (czcD), but unfortunately, we do not have data for those heavy metal stresses.
